note: Deterministic sample data for the Inhouse app. Everything is invented. No real customer data.

fixedClock.label: Monday, November 16, 2026
fixedClock.rule: One clock (decision D5): the demo opens at 8:00 AM on Monday, November 16, 2026, in the device's local time. The time zone in Settings is the one shown there; it doesn't move the clock. Shown times are 12-hour ("6:00 AM"); in a list, today shows a time, the six days before a weekday ("Fri, Nov 13"), older a date ("Nov 2"). Sample times are written from the demo's Monday ("-1d 16:40") and the app shows them through src/lib/format.ts.
